poll.q: Aaj ki sab se bari khabar kaun si hai — petrol sasta, GPT-6 Cyber, ya Fa'az missile?
options: ⛽ Petrol Rs9.41 sasta — chauthe din musalsal kami
🤖 GPT-6 Cyber — hacking AI, sirf vetted teams ko
🚀 Fa'az missile — Pakistan ka pehla apna air-to-air missile
💰 Claude ab bank parh sakta hai — dekh sakta hai, chhoo nahi sakta

https://www.reuters.com/technology/opena.what: OpenAI ne GPT-6 Cyber launch kiya — security research ke liye model jo flaws dhoond kar un ke working exploits bhi bana sakta hai. Firefox mein 81 unknown flaws, Linux kernel ki 948 vulnerabilities ke exploits. Sirf Daybreak Red ke approved customers ko access.
https://www.reuters.com/technology/opena.why: Attackers bhi AI use kar rahe hain — defender ko un se tez hona par raha hai. Ek model jo exploit bana sakta hai, wo hi bata sakta hai ke aap ka system kahan se tootega.
https://www.reuters.com/technology/opena.next: Dekhna ye hai ke independent evaluators is ke 48.5% ExploitGym score ko verify karte hain ya nahi — aur kya ye model kabhi aam developers tak pahunchega ya hamesha gated rahega.
https://www.reuters.com/technology/opena.take: Meri take: ye model ek hi waqt mein sab se useful aur sab se khatarnaak cheez hai jo OpenAI ne banayi hai. 'Critical' rating sahi hai — lekin sawal ye hai ke jab ek AI exploit likhna seekh jaye, to wo seekh kahan jaati hai? OpenAI ka Daybreak Red gate is ka jawab hai, lekin gate jitna mazboot ho, leak ka risk utna hi bara hota hai. Defenders ke liye khushkhabri, baaqi sab ke liye warning.

https://www.reuters.com/business/anthrop.what: Claude mein Personal Finance beta — bank aur card accounts Plaid se link karo, Claude spending, balance aur bills ke sawal jawab dega. Read-only: paisa move nahi kar sakta. Sirf US, Pro/Max/Ultra plans.
https://www.reuters.com/business/anthrop.why: ChatGPT ne 6 mahine pehle yehi kiya tha — ab Claude ki bari hai. AI assistants ka agla maidan aap ka bank account hai, kyun ke jo aap ka paisa samajhta hai, wo aap ki zindagi samajhta hai.
https://www.reuters.com/business/anthrop.next: US ke bahar kab aayega, koi date nahi — Pakistan to door ki baat hai. Aur asal test tab hoga jab Claude koi ghalat hisaab de aur user us par bharosa kar ke faisla kar le.
https://www.reuters.com/business/anthrop.take: Meri take: read-only hona achhi baat hai — Claude dekh sakta hai, chhoo nahi sakta. Lekin ye mat bhoolo ke 'sirf dekhna' bhi data hai: aap ki 2 saal ki spending history ek AI ke paas ja rahi hai. Anthropic kehta hai chats training ke liye use nahi hongi — is waade par nazar rakhna. Pakistani users ke liye abhi ye khabar sirf dekhne ki hai, use karne ki nahi.

https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/te.what: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generally available — 15 second ki native video, multi-turn editing, behtar reference following, aur qeemat 30% kam ($0.07/sec 720p). Gemini API aur business par live.
https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/te.why: AI video ki race mein ab lambi clip aur sasti qeemat hi jeet ka rasta hai — 10 second se 15 second matlab poora ad spot ek generation mein, bina stitching ke.
https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/te.next: Dekhna ye hai ke Pakistani creators isay kab aur kis qeemat par use kar paate hain — Gemini app par 15 second clips sirf Ultra subscribers ko mil rahe hain, aur rollout dheere hai.
https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/te.take: Meri take: 15 second chhota lagta hai, lekin yehi woh line hai jahan AI video 'demo' se 'kaam ki cheez' ban jata hai. Aur 30% sasta hona bhi wahi signal hai — Google ab video generation ko premium toy nahi, bulk utility bana raha hai. Lekin SynthID watermark yaad rakhna: jo video banao, wo pehchani jayegi — aur ye achhi baat hai.

https://the-decoder.com/baidu-releases-e.what: Baidu ne ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base open kar diya — 280B parameters, har token par sirf 14B active, 33.5T tokens par trained, 1M context. Weights Hugging Face par hain, lekin ye raw base model hai — na fine-tuning, na post-training — aur license EU/UK/South Korea mein use rokta hai.
https://the-decoder.com/baidu-releases-e.why: China ki open-source race mein Baidu ne 16 mahine baad wapsi ki hai — ERNIE 4.5 ke baad 5.0 aur 5.1 band rahe. Ab wo DeepSeek aur Tencent ko challenge kar raha hai, lekin apni shartein par.
https://the-decoder.com/baidu-releases-e.next: Post-trained version ka intezar hai — jab tak wo nahi aata, is base model ki asal taqat ka andaza koi nahi laga sakta. Aur benchmarks abhi sirf Baidu ke apne hain.
https://the-decoder.com/baidu-releases-e.take: Meri take: 'open-source' likhna aur open-source hona do alag cheezein hain. EU/UK/Korea ban aur $50M revenue wali shart ke saath ye open weights hain, open license nahi. Phir bhi — 280B ka model free mein milna chhoti baat nahi. Jo developer isay fine-tune karega, wo asal mein Baidu ki research par apna ghar bana raha hai. Bas ye yaad rakho ke ghar ki buniyad kisi aur ki hai.

https://www.techrepublic.com/article/new.what: OpenAI Images 2.6 — ChatGPT mein GIF generation, 50% tez image creation, saved reference images, aur API par do naye models (Flare for speed, Sunburst for quality). Har hafte 4 billion images ban rahi hain.
https://www.techrepublic.com/article/new.why: Static image se GIF tak ka safar matlab hai ke ChatGPT ab sirf tasveer nahi, movement bhi bana raha hai — aur jo tool GIF bana sakta hai, wo social media ka kaam aadha kar deta hai.
https://www.techrepublic.com/article/new.next: GIF creation abhi roll out ho raha hai — sab ko nahi mila. Aur dekhna ye hai ke Flare ki 6-second speed asal istemal mein bhi waisi hi rehti hai ya sirf low quality par.
https://www.techrepublic.com/article/new.take: Meri take: 4 billion images per week sun kar hairani hoti hai — ye number batata hai ke AI image ab experiment nahi, infrastructure hai. GIF wala feature chhota lagta hai lekin asal mein sab se zyada istemal hone wala hoga — kyun ke har banda meme aur reaction GIF chahta hai, poster nahi. Bas itna yaad rakhna: tez hona aur acha hona do alag cheezein hain.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2042367/petrol.what: Petrol Rs9.41 sasta ho kar Rs352.59, diesel Rs5.56 kam ho kar Rs382.25 — chauthe din musalsal kami. OGRA notification ke mutabiq petrol par ab bhi Rs114 aur diesel par Rs100 per litre tax aur duties hain.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2042367/petrol.why: Refineries 30 din ke liye petroleum levy ka Rs15 billion ka bojh utha rahi hain — isi liye qeemat gir rahi hai. Aur July se daily pricing mechanism hai, is liye har subah nayi qeemat.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2042367/petrol.next: Ye relief 30 din ke arrangement par khara hai — jab arrangement khatam hoga, to qeemat phir kya hogi, ye sab se bara sawal hai. Aur daily mechanism ka matlab ye bhi hai ke kal subah qeemat phir badh bhi sakti hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2042367/petrol.take: Meri take: Rs9.41 ki kami achhi khabar hai, lekin ye mat bhoolo ke petrol ab bhi Rs352 ka hai — aur is mein Rs114 sirf tax hai. Asal relief tab hoga jab tax kam ho, sirf qeemat nahi. Phir bhi, chauthe din kami ka matlab hai ke system kaam kar raha hai — bas ye dekhna hai ke ye 30 din ka arrangement khatam hone ke baad bhi chalta hai ya nahi.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2041885.what: Pakistan ne apne pehle indigenously developed air-to-air missile Fa'az ka kamyab flight test kiya — JF-17 se launch, terminal guidance system, lambi range par hawai ahdaaf ko nishana bana sakta hai. Ek mahine mein teesra bara missile test.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041885.why: Apna missile banana matlab hai ke aap ko har dafa bahar se khareedna nahi parhta — aur jab tension ho, to supplier ki marzi par nahi, apni marzi par hote ho.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041885.next: ISPR ne range aur speed nahi batayi — GIDS ke mutabiq 100km+ aur Mach 3.5. Asal sawal ye hai ke ye missile kab operational hoga aur PAF ki squadrons mein kab shamil hoga.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041885.take: Meri take: ye test is liye khaas hai ke ye sirf ek missile nahi, ek capability hai — Pakistan ab hawa mein bhi apna hathiyar khud bana sakta hai. Lekin is khushi mein ye mat bhoolo ke missile ki asal taqat us ki range nahi, us ki reliability hai — aur wo sirf waqt aur mazeed tests se sabit hoti hai.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2042348.what: SAFF Championship opener mein Pakistan India se 3-2 se haar gaya — half-time par 3-0 peeche, phir stoppage time mein Najeebullah ka header aur Alamgir Ghazi ka overhead kick. Ab semi-final ke liye Sunday ko Maldives se jeetna zaroori hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2042348.why: India ke khilaf match sirf 3 points ka nahi hota — ye izzat ka match hota hai. Aur jab aap 3-0 se peeche ho kar bhi wapas aate ho, to wo haar mein bhi ek jeet hoti hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2042348.next: Sunday 8 November ko Maldives ke khilaf match — jeeto to semi-final ki umeed zinda, haaro to group stage se wapsi. Aur diaspora players FIFA window ke baad shamil honge.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2042348.take: Meri take: Alamgir ka overhead kick is match ki sab se bari baat hai — ek aisi goal jo saalon yaad rehti hai. Lekin sach ye bhi hai ke pehle half mein 3 goals khana aur penalty miss karna bata raha hai ke team abhi bari teams ke khilaf poori tayyar nahi. Solano ka 'no excuses' theek hai — lekin excuses ke baghair bhi, mehnat ke baghair kuch nahi hota.

https://epaper.dawn.com/DetailNews.php?S.what: World Bank ki International Debt Report 2026 ke mutabiq Pakistan ka total external debt 2025 tak khatam hone wali dahai mein taqreeban dugna ho kar $135.1 billion ho gaya.
https://epaper.dawn.com/DetailNews.php?S.why: Qarz lena bura nahi — lekin jab qarz dugna ho jaye aur us se banne wali cheezein nazar na aayein, to sawal banta hai ke paisa gaya kahan.
https://epaper.dawn.com/DetailNews.php?S.next: Is report ke baad ab budget aur IMF talks mein ye number baar baar aayega — aur har naye qarz par yehi sawal uthenga ke wapsi ka plan kya hai.
https://epaper.dawn.com/DetailNews.php?S.take: Meri take: $135.1 billion sirf ek number nahi, ek bojh hai jo har Pakistani ke sar par hai — chahe wo janta ho ya nahi. Petrol sasta hona achha hai, lekin jab tak qarz ki kahani nahi badalti, relief hamesha temporary rahega. Asal khabar ye nahi ke qarz kitna hai — asal khabar ye hai ke hum isay wapas kaise karenge.

https://www.nation.com.pk/06-Nov-2026/pm.what: 2026 ka 9th polio case Khyber district se — 7 mahine ka bacha. 7 cases KP se, 2 Sindh se. PM Shehbaz ne ek hafte mein chaaron subon se mashawarat kar ke comprehensive strategy mang li. 2-8 November ki campaign Pakistan aur Afghanistan mein ek saath chal rahi hai.
https://www.nation.com.pk/06-Nov-2026/pm.why: Polio sirf ek bache ki bimari nahi — ye is baat ka test hai ke kya hum har ghar tak pahunch sakte hain. Jab virus Afghanistan se aata hai, to sirf Pakistan ki koshish kaafi nahi.
https://www.nation.com.pk/06-Nov-2026/pm.next: Ek hafte mein jo strategy aayegi, us mein dekhna ye hai ke Khyber aur Bannu jese high-risk areas mein teams ki security aur access ka kya plan hai — kyun ke wahan hi cases barh rahe hain.
https://www.nation.com.pk/06-Nov-2026/pm.take: Meri take: 9 cases ka number chhota lagta hai, lekin polio mein ek case bhi zyada hai — kyun ke ek case matlab hai ke virus abhi bhi zinda hai. Achi baat ye hai ke Punjab mein February 2025 ke baad koi case nahi aur Balochistan mein 2 saal se koi case nahi — matlab eradication mumkin hai. Lekin jab tak Khyber mein virus hai, koi bacha mehfooz nahi.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2042369.what: NCCIA ne Karachi ki Sharea Faisal par Voxtron Solutions call centre par raid kar ke 273 log giraftar kiye — 339 laptops, 152 phones zabt. Ilzaam: foreign nationals ko bank aur debt validation ke naam par call kar ke un ki personal aur card details nikalna. NCCIA ke mutabiq Karachi mein taqreeban 350 aise call centres hain.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2042369.why: Ye sirf ek raid nahi — ye Pakistan ki image ka sawal hai. Jab dunya mein 'Pakistani call centre' ka matlab scam ban jaye, to har genuine call centre aur har freelancer ki izzat daao par lag jati hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2042369.next: Court ne 9 key suspects ka 2 din ka remand diya — ab forensic analysis batayegi ke network kitna bara tha aur paisa kahan gaya. Aur 350 centres wale dawe par agla action kya hoga, ye bhi dekhna hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2042369.take: Meri take: 273 giraftariyan bari khabar hain, lekin is mein 42 nabaligh aur 100+ khawateen bhi hain — ye batata hai ke ye scam sirf kuch criminals ka kaam nahi, ek poora system hai jismein berozgar naujawan phans rahe hain. Raid karna zaroori hai, lekin asal hal ye hai ke naujawanon ko legal kaam mile — warna ek centre band hoga, doosra khul jayega.

mood: ⛽ Petrol sasta, 🚀 Fa'az test, 🤖 AI ki nayi race — aaj relief bhi, taqat bhi, aur ek bara sawal bhi.
